decisions.title: The Host Owns the Completion Gate
decisions.description: The working model may request to stop, but the harness evaluates the active goal before returning. Completion is a program decision at the turn boundary.
decisions.alternatives: Asking the working model whether it is finished is simpler, but lets the same actor make and verify its own claim.

zh.title: 完成闸门由宿主持有
zh.description: 工作模型可以请求停止，但 harness 会在 return 前评估 active goal。是否完成是轮次边界上的程序决策。

ja.title: 完了ゲートはホストが所有する
ja.description: 作業モデルは停止を要求できるが、harness は return 前に active goal を評価する。完了は turn 境界でのプログラム判断である。

decisions.title: Evidence Trust Comes from the Ingress Path
decisions.description: Ordinary submit calls cannot attach trusted labels. Only an allowlisted host-event channel can deliver task or monitor evidence, so user and model prose cannot certify itself.
decisions.alternatives: Trusting text content or caller-supplied labels makes the evidence boundary forgeable.

zh.title: 证据信任来自入口路径
zh.description: 普通 submit 不能附加可信标签；只有白名单宿主事件通道能送入 task 或 monitor 证据，因此用户与模型文本不能自证完成。

ja.title: 証拠の信頼は入力経路から得る
ja.description: 通常の submit は trusted label を付けられず、allowlist 済み host event channel だけが task や monitor evidence を届ける。ユーザーやモデルの文章は自己証明できない。

decisions.title: Every Automatic Continuation Needs a Budget
decisions.description: An unmet goal queues another turn only while budget remains. Exhaustion marks the goal blocked and releases the gate instead of creating an infinite loop.
decisions.alternatives: An unbounded goal is persistent, but an impossible condition can consume resources forever.

zh.title: 每次自动续轮都必须有预算
zh.description: 目标未满足时只在预算剩余时继续；耗尽后将目标标记为 blocked 并释放闸门，避免无限循环。

ja.title: 自動継続には必ず予算を置く
ja.description: goal 未達時は予算が残る間だけ次の turn を追加する。使い切れば blocked にして gate を解放し、無限 loop を防ぐ。
